scenario: Multi-line aggregation collisions require labels per LSER.6.8.3. When two observation lines on the same slot cover the same aggregation under different time models, the compiler must reject the declaration unless every line covering that aggregation carries `as <label>`. Pin: two unlabelled lines both declaring `mean` (under different time models) reject with DS_VALIDATE_SERIES_DUPLICATE_AGG_NEEDS_LABEL.
rules_ds:
schema Sensor scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    state: Float mutable

series Sensor.state:
    mean sliding 10_min
    mean sliding 1_h
